title: How do you ensure a .NET API can handle 10,000 concurrent requests?
description: Use async everywhere, connection pooling, caching, and horizontal scaling.

data.text: Question: How do you ensure a .NET API can handle 10,000 concurrent requests?
Use async I/O, optimize connection pooling, add caching layers, and scale horizontally behind a load balancer.

items: Async all the way: async controllers, repositories, and DB calls
Connection pooling: configure max pool size and connection lifetime
Caching: response caching, distributed Redis cache
Thread pool: avoid blocking calls, use ValueTask for hot paths
Scaling: horizontal pod autoscaling or VM scale sets
When do you use a CDN vs application cache?

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Scale horizontally when single-node limits are hit
